stroke_in.note: 73.7 mm. CONFLICT settled by arithmetic: Consumer Guide says the L24 stroke was 73.0 mm. 83 x 83 x 73.7 x 0.7854 x 6 = 2,392.6 cc matches the 2,393 cc published by Nissan, Elgin, Consumer Guide and Wikipedia; 73.0 mm would give 2,369.8 cc. Only one explicit source for 73.7.
